senses.gloss:
Krauḍa
a Vedic Śākhā mentioned in Mahābhāṣya IV. 2. 66.

Krauṣṭuki
Q. in Yāska's Nirukta VIII. 1, 3.

Krauṣṭuki
son of Garga. Same a. Ṛṣiputra, authority on Nimitta.
See NCC. III. p. 43a.

Krauṣṭukī
ancient authority on Vedic prosody. cited by Piṅgala in his Chandas III. 29, a. son of Garga; mentioned by Bhaṭṭotpala on Bṛhatsaṁhitā I. 9.
See Ind. Stud. 8. p. 243.
C.. above.
